description:
Welcome to Inventor Nhat!

On Inventor Nhat Channel, I share and guide you: DIY, Creativity, Life Hacks, Recycle, Reuse, Simple Inventions, Creative Ideas, How to Make, Useful Tips and Tricks.

Here you will find DIY TV antennas and signal projects, homemade welding machines and 12V welders, workshop tool hacks, drill-bit and knife sharpening, and practical electronics experiments. This channel brings you creative ideas for turning old phones, chargers, speakers, batteries, cables, motors and everyday materials into useful tools and practical devices. Antenna projects include clear building steps, reception troubleshooting, signal comparisons and real-world tests for legal free over-the-air television.

Everything is made and tested by my own hands! If you find these creative DIY videos useful, please subscribe to the channel, share the videos and let me know your opinion in the comments!
